Comment "REDO" and I'll DM you the repo link to the free Claude tutor that re-tests only what you missed. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: how it works, and the catch.

1. You hand it your notes or files, and it chops your subject into a map of steps.

2. It quizzes you on every step, and a fixed gate decides if you can move on. One or two right answers aren't enough to count as mastered.

3. Practice brings your mistakes back on a review schedule, and it can make video lessons with captions that play in your browser.

4. It's free and open source (Apache 2.0), past 54,000 GitHub stars, and it signs in through Claude Code, so a Claude plan works with no API key.

The catch: you install it yourself on your computer, and Claude use counts against your plan. It's a study tool, so follow your school's rules on AI.

For the repo link, comment "REDO".
